concepts.title: True pentagonal base
concepts.instruction: Construct the 40 mm pentagon in plan in the specified orientation and locate its centre o.

concepts.title: Reference apex
concepts.instruction: Project the base and mark o′ at 80 mm to form the reference elevation.

concepts.title: Isometric bounding construction
concepts.instruction: Draw the isometric enclosing rectangle and transfer all five base-vertex offsets.

concepts.title: Base centre
concepts.instruction: Transfer the centre to the isometric base with the retained centre/construction lines.

concepts.title: Locate apex O
concepts.instruction: Erect the vertical axis from the centre and set off 80 mm.

concepts.title: Slant edges
concepts.instruction: Join O to each of A, B, C, D and E individually, then retain the source base and hidden-edge convention.

concepts.title: Dimension and label
concepts.instruction: Add the base-side and axis dimensions and labels.
